title: Dental PPO Plans Requested Allowance on Second-Level Claim Appeals
content:
Appeals provision, Dental PPO Plans. On a second-level post-service appeal under the claim-appeal rule, the allowance the payment requested is figured on follows the reduction the member contests, and so decides the amount in dispute:

| Line under appeal | Requested allowance |
|---|---|
| A posterior composite filling on a plan with the posterior composite alternate benefit, or a porcelain or ceramic crown on a molar on a plan with the molar crown alternate benefit | The lesser of the billed procedure's full allowed amount and the billed amount |
| Any other line whose billed amount is below the allowance the decision under appeal used | The billed amount |
| Otherwise | The allowance the decision under appeal used |

Porcelain or ceramic crowns are CDT D2740, D2750, D2751, D2752 and D2783; molars are teeth 1, 2, 3, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 30, 31 and 32. The posterior composite alternate benefit is on Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250 and Plus 1500; the molar crown alternate benefit is on Classic 1250 and Plus 1500.

### Cases (hypothetical amounts)
| Line | Billed | Allowed | Allowance used by the decision | Requested allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Posterior composite, Classic 1250 | 226.00 | 198.70 | 131.40 (alternate) | 198.70 |
| Posterior composite, Classic 1250 | 170.00 | 198.70 | 131.40 (alternate) | 170.00 |
| Amalgam filling, Elite 2500 | 88.00 | 112.30 | 112.30 | 88.00 |
| Root canal, Elite 2500 | 990.00 | 845.10 | 845.10 | 845.10 |
